status.en: 95 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 30% more than the week before, most of them in Tehran, Minab and Sistan.
status.nb: 95 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 30 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Teheran, Minab og Sistan.

summary.en: Iran has sunk two container ships in the Strait of Hormuz, raising the risk to regional shipping, while its precision strikes have damaged Gulf infrastructure and limited US war plans. Houthi forces have hit Saudi Aramco headquarters and a Saudi airport with missiles and drones, prompting Saudi air strikes on Houthi sites in Yemen. US officials are reportedly considering deploying the "mother of all bombs" against Iran if fighting resumes. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iran har senket to containerskip i Hormuzstredet, noe som øker risikoen for regional skipsfart, mens presisjonsangrepene deres har skadet infrastruktur i Persiabukta og begrenset USAs krigsplaner. Houthiene har truffet Saudi Aramcos hovedkvarter og en saudisk flyplass med missiler og droner, noe som har ført til saudiske luftangrep på houthi-steder i Jemen. Amerikanske tjenestemenn vurderer ifølge rapporter å bruke «the mother of all bombs» mot Iran dersom kampene gjenopptas. 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

posts.text:
A container ship has sunk in the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by an Iranian attack amid an escalation in violence in the critical waterway.

The Singapore-registered vessel, the GFS Pride, was one of four ships struck in the strait on Tuesday.
